description_en: Queries the quota dimensions supported by a specified Alibaba Cloud service
description_zh: 查询目标云产品支持的配额维度
name: ListProductQuotaDimensions

parameters.help_en: The token that marks the position from which to start the query. If you leave this parameter empty, the query starts from the beginning
parameters.help_zh: 用来标记开始查询数据的位置。置空表示从头开始
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of records to return for a single query.

Valid values: 1 to 200. Default value: 30
parameters.help_zh:
本次查询的最大记录条数。

取值范围：1~200。默认值：30
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The abbreviation of the Alibaba Cloud service name.

For more information about how to obtain the abbreviation of an Alibaba Cloud service name, see the `ProductCode` parameter in https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html
parameters.help_zh:
云产品的缩写名称。

关于如何获取云产品的缩写名称，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/440555.html中的0
parameters.name: product_code

parameters.help_en:
The quota category. Valid values:

FlowControl: API rate limit quotas.

CommonQuota (default): general quotas.

Privileges (WhiteListLabel) do not have quota dimensions
parameters.help_zh:
配额种类。取值：

FlowControl：API速率配额。

CommonQuota（默认值）：通用配额。

权益配额（WhiteListLabel）无配额维度
parameters.name: quota_category

NextToken.description_en: The token that marks the position of the next query. If this parameter is not returned, it indicates that all data has been queried
NextToken.description_zh: 用来标记返回查询数据的位置。未返回表示数据已经查询完毕
